description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different categories within a dataset of 1.4 million open-source distilled reasoning examples, designed to support large language model training. The largest segment, colored light red, represents “Math” at 29.3% (410,756 instances), followed by “Coding” in blue at 24.3% (339,907 instances), and “Information Seeking” in light green at 22.2% (311,427 instances). “Reasoning” (orange) accounts for 10.4% (145,329 instances), while “Others (combined)” (light green) makes up 9.3% (130,671 instances). Smaller segments include “Planning” (lavender, 2.3%, 31,757 instances) and “Creative Writing” (pink, 2.2%, 30,144 instances). A legend on the top left matches each category to its color and raw count, while percentage labels are displayed directly on the corresponding slices. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of Math, Coding, and Information Seeking, with the remaining categories comprising a smaller, more fragmented portion of the dataset.
